people.name: Stephen
people.line: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.

translations.web: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’
translations.bsb: And when the blood of Your witness Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and watching over the garments of those who killed him.’
translations.kjv: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
translations.asv: and when the blood of Stephen thy witness was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting, and keeping the garments of them that slew him.
